newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam general calls for military telecom upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam general calls for military telecom upgrade.

text.p: Lieutenant-General Le Kha Phieu, a senior member of Hanoi's elite politburo, has called for an upgrading of communications technology for Vietnam's armed forces.

Wednesday's Quan Doi Nhan Dan (People's Army) newspaper said Phieu had told members of the Army Signal Corps that full use should be made of the most-up-to-date techniques and information technology available.
He also said military and civilian scientists should work together to improve military communication systems.
Vietnam's military is estimated at 572,000 people backed up by a strategic rear force of three to four million.
Its 20th century fighting successes are well-documented but defence analysts say much of its equipment is outdated.
